task_description: Write a method in Dafny to reverse words seperated by spaces in a given string.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method ReverseWords(s: string) returns (v: string)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - The length of the returning string must be the same as the length of the input string
- The order of words in the output string is the reverse of their order in the input string
- All words are separated by a single space in the output
- The individual words' characters remain unchanged
- The positions of spaces are preserved, with words reversed in position only
